Chapter 788: Chapter 10: Martial Ancestor Descends to the Mortal World (Subscribe Please)_2

The influx of cosmic breath was indeed the Origin Power of the Tianqing World.

For hundreds of thousands of years, each ritual involved the Martial Ancestor Golden Body absorbing the world’s Origin Power, making its foundation unbelievably solid.

“In just under half a stick of incense time, I will have complete control over this physical body,”

Lin Yuan intimately felt the profound mysteries of the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, the strongest flesh he cultivated for himself, and was naturally extremely satisfied.

Actually, with Lin Yuan’s control abilities, he could control this physical body now, but doing so would cause some negligible flaws, which were altogether unnecessary.

The humans in the Tianqing World were, indeed, being ravaged by the powers of those two Foreign Evil Gods, but it had not yet reached a fundamental level; Lin Yuan could afford to wait a bit longer.

...

Inside the Martial Hall.

A large number of believers and Martial Dao Cultivators gradually left.

In the end, only the Great Priest of Martial Hall remained.

The Great Priest, named Qingyao, was the descendant of the first generation leader of the Tianqing Alliance from hundreds of thousands of years ago.

Having served the Tianqing Alliance Leader, Lin Yuan, for countless years, his descendants were naturally esteemed and became the highest-ranking High Priest in the Tianqing World today.

“Martial Ancestor…”

Qingyao looked up at the towering golden body of the Martial Ancestor with a slightly anxious gaze, “If those two Foreign Evil Gods continue like this, within a year, seventy percent of the Tianqing World’s human lands will be completely overrun, and then the entire world will be thoroughly corrupted.”

As the High Priest, whose soul was bound to the Ancestral Demon Tree, Qingyao could vaguely sense the precarious situation faced by the entire Tianqing World.

“Therefore, we must completely resist the power of those two Foreign Evil Gods before then.”

Qingyao had already made up her mind, “I will sacrifice the flesh and souls of half of the life in this realm to help Sacred Tree recover, and then, with the power of Sacred Tree, we still have a chance to hold off those two Evil God Temples.”

Qingyao’s expression gradually calmed down.

To sacrifice the flesh and souls of half of the life in this realm, she, as the officiant of the ritual, would certainly not survive and would turn into nourishment for the Sacred Tree along with countless other beings.

But as long as it could protect the Tianqing World, even the greatest sacrifice was worth it.

…

Outside the Tianqing World.

In the Boundless Void.

Two massive Foreign Evil Gods stood in front of a huge fissure in the world’s barrier, scrutinizing everything inside.

“Demon Tree brother, you just need to hand over this world and proactively disclose why the Origin Source of this world has grown so rapidly. I will speak well of you in front of our Pavilion Master, perhaps you could become a trusted retainer,”

The Foreign Evil God on the left emitted terrifying mental fluctuations, trying to communicate with the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Since the invasion began, they had often done this, aiming to subdue without a fight, but it had hardly been effective.

Moments later.

The Foreign Evil God on the left looked displeased.

Previously, whenever it asked, the Ancestral Demon Tree would, at least, reply a few words,

Even if just to stall for time.

But now,

The Ancestral Demon Tree wasn’t paying it any attention.

“Arrogant, even in this dire state,”

The Foreign Evil God on the right was also somewhat dissatisfied.

They believed they held an overwhelming advantage and thought that if not for the reluctance to pay the price, they could have already conquered the Tianqing World and captured the Demon Tree.

“Forget it.”

“No need to stall anymore.”

“Let our true bodies enter directly,”

The Foreign Evil God on the left was already growing impatient.

After a period of testing and attrition, it believed that even if the Demon Tree still had some resistance, it wouldn’t amount to much.

At this moment, should the two Evil Gods force their way in, even under the Demon Tree’s counterattack, they would likely not suffer much damage.

Rustle rustle rustle.

The next moment.

Within the Tianqing World, under the protection domain of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Innumerable beings were terrified to discover that the horrifying crack spanning across the sky had suddenly torn open even further.

A massive Foreign Evil God, covered in numerous tentacles, was slowly squeezing through.

The entire Tianqing World trembled faintly as this massive Evil God entered, with the edges of the land directly fracturing.

The rushing sound of water.

On the other side, a similarly abyss-like crack tore open, and an eye the size of a million miles squeezed through, surrounded by wings and emitting a swiftly spreading, sinister and strange aura.

…

Canopy Continent.

Inside the Martial Hall.

The High Priest Qingyao’s expression drastically changed.

“This is bad.”

Qingyao suddenly stood up, and although she didn’t see it with her own eyes, she could feel two massive and horrifying presences rapidly invading the entire Tianqing World.

“We can’t delay any longer.”

“We need to make a sacrifice of half of the beings to the Sacred Tree right now.”

Qingyao immediately began issuing orders, with Martial Dao Cultivators appearing outside the Martial Hall, ready to be sacrificed at any moment to heal the Sacred Tree’s injuries.

They had long been prepared for this, willing to be sacrificed if it could save the Tianqing World.

“Martial Ancestor…”

“I hope the Martial Ancestor blesses us, and everything goes smoothly.”

Before Qingyao left the Martial Hall to formally preside over the sacrifice, she subconsciously wanted to glance at the Martial Ancestor Golden Body she had admired until now.

Although sacrificing half of the world’s beings could heal the Sacred Tree’s injuries,

It was still uncertain whether it could stop those two Foreign Evil Gods.

After all, the Sacred Tree had been severely damaged by unknown means by those two Evil Gods at the height of its power, ripping apart the Tianqing World as well.

However,

High Priest Qingyao was shocked when she turned her head back.

Because the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, which had stood unmoved in the deepest part of the Martial Hall for tens of thousands of years, had now disappeared.

“Where is the Martial Ancestor?”

High Priest Qingyao was struck as if by lightning, for the Martial Ancestor was not only her faith but also the faith of all beings in the Tianqing World. The disappearance of the Martial Ancestor Golden Body was akin to the sky falling for her.

High Priest Qingyao staggered backward several steps, about to exit the Martial Hall to investigate who had approached the Martial Hall during this time,

but she froze in place.

Because, at the entrance of the Martial Hall, stood a tall man, unknown when he appeared.

The tall man, with his hands behind his back, turned his back to Qingyao.

“There’s no need to sacrifice half the beings,” Lin Yuan said, glancing at High Priest Qingyao and speaking indifferently.

High Priest Qingyao had contacted the Ancestral Demon Tree, intending to sacrifice half the beings to heal the Demon Tree’s injuries, and Lin Yuan was naturally well aware of this.

And Lin Yuan naturally did not want to sacrifice half the beings of the Tianqing World – how many Martial Dao Cultivators would that be?

“Martial Ancestor…”

Upon hearing these words, High Priest Qingyao trembled, tears moistening her eyes immediately.

Martial Ancestor.

The Martial Ancestor, worshipped by the beings of the Tianqing World for hundreds of thousands of years, had finally returned.

Lin Yuan, still facing away from High Priest Qingyao, took a step, stepping out of the Martial Hall.

…

Above the Earth, numerous rampaging Evil God Puppets were annihilated instantly, crushed by a terrifying power that reduced them to nothingness; the remnants of their Origin Source were absorbed by the Tianqing World.

The two massive, terrifying barrier cracks spanning across the sky, within which the two overjoyed Foreign Evil Gods wished to squeeze into this world, seemed to sense something.

They looked up towards the Canopy Continent, their expressions showing a trace of fear, not even thinking before they began to retreat, their massive bodies colliding with the cracks in a desperate manner.

…

Martial Ancestor left the Martial Hall and descended to the mortal realm.
